verdict.rationale: Cursor's docs explicitly claim it 'reviews PRs in GitHub' and can 'inspect diffs, run checks, and catch problems before you merge,' directly matching automated PR review with contextual feedback, backed by GitHub/GitLab/Bitbucket integration claims. missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of review quality, details on triggering on every PR automatically, and no community corroboration of this specific feature.
